_note: ADVISORY bands only - never hard cutoffs. check_content_depth.py consults these solely for content-bearing page intents (product, service, article, homepage, category) and flags 'below_reference_range' ONLY when word count, paragraph count, and text-to-markup ratio all three agree the page is thin. Utility, app, media and unknown intents are never scored. Bands are deliberately low to catch only genuinely empty content pages.
